property: Reno retains Tahoe-era fast retransmit and adds fast recovery so duplicate-ACK loss detection does not immediately collapse the sender back to slow start.

date_or_range.notes: Implementation generations, not TCP wire-version numbers.

sources.supports: Tahoe first fast retransmit; Reno first fast recovery

negative_claims: This edge does not claim that Tahoe and Reno are formal TCP protocol versions.
This edge does not claim that every later TCP stack exactly reproduced BSD Reno behavior.
open_questions: Acquire and diff period Tahoe and Reno BSD tcp_input/tcp_output sources.
